challenge.title: Survive the storm
challenge.intro: An eight-sol global dust storm is approaching. Choose whether to drive, study rocks, or sleep each sol to prevent your battery from draining to zero.
challenge.hint: When the sky goes dark, sleeping draws zero extra power and preserves the heaters.

signal_note: A massive 2018 dust storm darkened the sky over Perseverance Valley, depleting the rover's solar power.
ending: Opportunity explored Mars for nearly 15 years, discovering definitive proof of ancient Martian water.
